extracted.intended_audience: photojournalism enthusiasts, photographers, cultural tourists, and festival attendees
extracted.subtask_description: An event listing and overview for the Visa pour l'Image photojournalism festival (Perpignan, 30 Aug–14 Sep 2025) describing dates, programming, selection, venues and organisational details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Festival ethos / mission
rubrics_metrics.description: VISA stands staunchly firm: (re)discovering and promoting forgotten photographers, honouring those killed, imprisoned or silenced, confirming new talent and providing a public arena for discussion on current, but often difficult, topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In a climate where public trust in the media is declining, the festival represents a pillar of democracy, decency and humanity; programming and curation should reflect these values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programming mix: established, emerging and amateur work
rubrics_metrics.description: Featuring exhibitions by some of the world’s leading documentary photographers, as well as up-and-coming professionals and skilled amateurs (through the “OFF” programme of fringe events in local cafés, shops and other spaces).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The main programme showcases high-calibre professional documentary work while the OFF programme provides space for emerging talent and skilled amateurs in informal, local venues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection / competitive finalists
rubrics_metrics.description: Whittling down the thousands of worthy applications to just 20 finalists is no mean feat and goes to show the calibre of work on display.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection is highly competitive; only a small number of finalists are chosen from a large applicant pool, implying stringent curatorial standards (though explicit selection criteria are not listed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exhibition logistics and accessibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Exhibitions will be open from 10am to 8pm everyday, and entrance is free.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accessibility is emphasised through daily long opening hours and free admission; also note availability of online exhibitions via the site to broaden access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Screenings / evening projections format
rubrics_metrics.description: Evening projections of the year’s biggest news stories at the Campo Santo. Screenings begin with a chronological review of the year’s news stories, followed by reports and features on society, conflicts, and stories, both highly and little publicised. There will also be retrospectives of major events and figures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmers should structure screenings chronologically and include a mix of breaking news reviews, in-depth reports/features, under‑publicised stories, and retrospectives to document the year comprehensively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venue selection / cultural placement
rubrics_metrics.description: Exhibitions will be presented in the following historical and cultural spots of Perpignan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use of historical and cultural sites across the host city is part of the festival's identity; venues include both formal exhibition spaces and local cultural spots (see 'Visit Perpignan VISA venues' for details).

rubrics_metrics.name: OFF programme and fringe event integration
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'OFF' programme of fringe events takes place in local cafés, shops and other spaces, showcasing up-and-coming professionals and skilled amateurs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fringe programming should integrate with local businesses and informal venues to broaden participation and audience engagement outside main exhibition spaces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentary mandate: recording history and amplifying voices
rubrics_metrics.description: After 37 years, VISA continues to live up to its reputation as vital in documenting history and giving a voice to those who so often go unheard.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curatorial choices should prioritise documentary work that records historical events and amplifies marginalized or underreported voices, reinforcing the festival's role as a historical record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public communication and updates
rubrics_metrics.description: Watch this space for exhibitions, we’ll update the article as they’re announced (images here are from last year’s festival).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organisers/publishers should keep audiences informed with timely updates as exhibitions are announced; use illustrative images from previous years until new materials are available.
